notes.title: Battle System Adjustment Ver 1.47 Updated
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318875/4e78ba7fca69ba3a65c3daccf5a8942a3bf1355f.png[/img]

The team received feedbacks from various parties regarding the battle system over this weekend. We immediately addressed the feedback in attempts to better the game and the system.

Here are the following adjustments we made to the battle system:
1.    "Instant Victory" button: if the player failed and fled a battle five times during your save; an Instant Victory button will appear on screen. Clicking on it will result in an instant win.

2.    Skill cooldown will be reset to zero after each battle.

3.    The amount of chip available for purchase will be increased from one per week to 99 per week.

4.    New exploration item available for purchase: Max Durability Restoration.

5.    We lower the number of mobs in the Ammie’s side quest - Abandoned Factory.

6.    New chips will be available for purchase in Robomart.

Here are other adjustments we made to the game:
1.    Fixed the trigger event for the Destiny route.

2.    Translation errors.

Hope these changes will improve the gaming experience for you guys. If you have any other questions, please feel free to contact us on our Discord. Thank you for your support.

Sincerely,
Barance Studio

discord.gg/HUMTP7SWSb

The Agnietta – The Holy Healer and the Cursed Dungeon
[img]https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/2138450//extras/TITLE.png[/img]

[Story Background]
Our heroine is a demure, divine healer who accepts the task of purifying the cursed dungeon. 
Along the way, she may encounter all sorts of lust-filled demons. 
Can you help Demyra escape all the traps in the dungeon just waiting for a naive, innocent girl?

[Gameplay]
An action RPG from a overlook view.
During the game, the heroine may learn new skills due to various encounters.
Some skills may be purely positive attack skills, while others may have side effects on the body.

All battle contents and processes are shown on the game screen in real time.
And players can decide to fight or avoid difficult monsters according to the state of the heroine.

[Multiple body diagram]
There full of the monsters that will attack the heroine.
Most monsters may ""parasite"" on the heroine's body, and have a negative impact on the heroine.
Some dugeon puzzles or enemies even need to be solved by using the monsters that is on the heroine's body.
Moreover, the body diagram will also make changes immediately according to the current situation of the heroine. 
Please try more of the combinations there will be! 🙂

[Rich high-quality CG & continue to play after defeat]
There are high-quality and abundant differential CG in the game.
Most of the CG scenes entered by defeat will not lead to the end of the game.
Instead, the heroine will get up with some negative state and continue the game.
However, all the conditions of the heroine's body will be truthfully ""recorded"" and may affect the triggering of certain battles or plots.

notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41075428/af8dd19a7e0a19142e4e8125c533a1169aa06804.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41075428/ef04b3fff006d6c40fc6d7d9bbc93e844eb6d488.png[/img]
In a faraway world where gorgeous ladies are desperately seeking a hero, you volunteer to become their strategist with your tower defense expertise and an ulterior yet understandable motive in mind. Build towers wisely, level up heroines, obtain upgrades, and immerse in a stimulating harem love story!

[h2][b]Love story with beautiful heroic defenders, and... very hot scenes[/b][/h2]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1667130/extras/Gif2V2.gif?t=1640677983[/img]

Pulled into a distant and unfamiliar world, you get to meet its [b][i]gorgeous ladies[/i][/b], each with a [b][i]distinct personality[/i][/b]. While living and breathing the war with them, you learn about their story, their preferences, and style. Although it may take a while to earn their trust, it will turn out to be worth it eventually. 

Enjoy the [b]lovely interaction[/b] between the characters, the [b][i]cute harem love story[/i][/b], and the [i][b]breath-taking sex scenes[/b][/i]. The game features [i][b]a variety of sex scenes[/b][/i], there is something for everyone!

[h2][b]Compelling tower defense gameplay with real tactical depth[/b][/h2]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1667130/extras/Gif1V2.gif?t=1640677983[/img]
Facing up against the monster hordes, [b][i]building the right tower at the right position[/i][/b], and using the [b][i]right combination of towers[/i][/b] and the [b][i]right heroine[/i][/b] will be your key to victory. Each tower type is good against some types of enemies while being bad against some others, the same is also true for each heroine character. [b][i]Making good use of the heroine skills[/i][/b] can help you recover from dire situations. 

Frequently [i][b]leveling up your heroines[/b][/i], and [i][b]purchasing permanent tower and heroine skill upgrades[/b][/i] (using in-game currencies) will be another vital element to success.

[h2]Game Features:[/h2]
[list] 
[*] Kingdom Rush (TD) meets Hentai!
[*] Gorgeous anime-style artwork with high-quality animations
[*] Japanese voice-over for all ladies
[*] Engaging tactical tower defense gameplay
[*] Utilize and level up heroines
[*] Obtain permanent upgrades for towers and heroine skills
[*] Cute harem love story
[*] Variety of sex scenes
[/list]
